title: Portal frame under lateral load
description: Single-bay portal frame with a horizontal load H at beam level. Pinned bases are checked by statics, fixed bases by the classical rigid-frame formula and by the reference solver.
source: Statics; Kleinlogel, Rigid Frame Formulas (1952), frame with fixed feet under a horizontal load at the girder; independent reference solver

checks.label: Pinned bases: base shear H/2
checks.note: Exact only for an inextensible beam; the model area is very large, leaving a difference of a few parts per million.

checks.label: Pinned bases: knee moment Hh/2
checks.note: Exact only for an inextensible beam; the model area is very large, leaving a difference of a few parts per million.

checks.label: Pinned bases: sway vs reference solver
Fixed bases: base moment (Hh/2)(3k+1)/(6k+1)
checks.note: The formula neglects axial deformation; the model has a very large area so the difference is negligible.

Fixed bases: displacement difference vs reference (relative)
